svg.title: Correction-aware authoritative-state admission workflow
svg.desc: A persisted AI candidate enters a candidate-bound human decision. Accept preserves the candidate value, Correction retains the candidate while authorizing a distinct value, and Reject stops admission. A trusted transaction checks five information classes and policy, performs one version compare-and-swap, and either commits a complete authoritative successor with total source attribution or leaves state unchanged.
